facts.text: Tanvi Patri won badminton silver at the Dakar Youth Olympics, losing the final to World junior champion Zhang Yi Xin of China 21-15, 13-21, 24-26.
facts.plain: Tanvi Patri won badminton silver at the Dakar Youth Olympics, losing the final to World junior champion Zhang Yi Xin of China 21-15, 13-21, 24-26.

facts.text: India won its first-ever **aquatics medals at the Youth Olympics** (Dakar 2026, the 4th edition since 2010): Dhinidhi Desinghu won bronze in both 100m freestyle (56.27s, a new Indian women's best) and 200m freestyle (2:02.28s); Tirthank Pegu won bronze in men's 200m butterfly (2:01.25s), India's first male swimming medal at the Games.
facts.plain: India won its first-ever aquatics medals at the Youth Olympics (Dakar 2026, the 4th edition since 2010): Dhinidhi Desinghu won bronze in both 100m freestyle (56.27s, a new Indian women's best) and 200m freestyle (2:02.28s); Tirthank Pegu won bronze in men's 200m butterfly (2:01.25s), India's first male swimming medal at the Games.
keys: aquatics medals at the Youth Olympics

facts.text: Mitchell Starc reached **460 wickets in 110 Tests** (avg 25.97) — the most by any left-arm pacer in history — having passed Wasim Akram's 414 during the 2025-26 Ashes; his 2025 calendar year yielded 55 wickets in 11 Tests at an average of 17.32.
facts.plain: Mitchell Starc reached 460 wickets in 110 Tests (avg 25.97) — the most by any left-arm pacer in history — having passed Wasim Akram's 414 during the 2025-26 Ashes; his 2025 calendar year yielded 55 wickets in 11 Tests at an average of 17.32.

facts.text: Mohammed Shami retired from Test cricket with **229 wickets in 64 matches** over a 13-year career (debut vs West Indies, Eden Gardens, Nov 6, 2013); best figures 5/28 (Johannesburg, 2018); last Test was the 2023 WTC final at the Oval.
facts.plain: Mohammed Shami retired from Test cricket with 229 wickets in 64 matches over a 13-year career (debut vs West Indies, Eden Gardens, Nov 6, 2013); best figures 5/28 (Johannesburg, 2018); last Test was the 2023 WTC final at the Oval.

facts.text: **Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes) became the **youngest Formula 1 World Champion ever** — **20 years, 68 days** — beating Sebastian Vettel's record (23y 134d) by finishing third in Mexico City; he is the first Italian F1 champion since **Alberto Ascari (1953)** and drives car No. **12**, like his idol **Ayrton Senna**.

facts.text: India thrashed Korea **8-1** in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey semifinal in Mohali to reach its **6th ACT final in 7 editions**, where it will meet **Japan** (which beat Malaysia 5-3 on shootout) in the first-ever India-Japan ACT final.

facts.text: Former hockey captain **M.M. Somaya**'s **1980 Moscow Olympics gold medal** — India's last Olympic hockey gold — was stolen from his Bengaluru home, along with other medals and jewellery; Somaya played 3 Olympics (1980, 1984, 1988) and won the **Arjuna Award in 1985**.
